description: This file defines a template class TimerType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which implements a timer mechanism with scheduling, triggering, revoking, and processing functionalities. It also includes a nested class TimedInfo for managing scheduled content and a TimerType::TimeWorker class for thread-based execution. Additionally, it defines a template WatchDogType class for thread-based watchdog timers. The file includes other core modules like Module, Sync, Thread, and Time, and contains licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class implementing a scheduled timer with thread-based execution, supporting scheduling, triggering, revoking, and processing timer events.

classes.name: TimerType::TimedInfo
classes.description: A helper class representing scheduled content with a timestamp, supporting comparison and move semantics.

classes.name: TimerType::TimeWorker
classes.description: A thread class responsible for executing the timer's processing loop.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: A template class implementing a watchdog timer thread that can be armed, reset, and run a handler upon expiration.

methods.name: TimerType
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer thread, lock, and internal state.

methods.name: ~TimerType
methods.description: Destructor stopping the timer thread and cleaning up.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Overloaded methods to schedule timer events at specific times with content.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all pending timer events and blocks the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Schedules an event to trigger at a specific time, replacing existing entries.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a specific content entry from the schedule.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled events.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop of the timer thread, executing scheduled events when their time arrives.

methods.name: ScheduleEntry
methods.description: Inserts a new timed info into the schedule, maintaining order.

methods.name: Arm
methods.description: Arms the watchdog timer with a specified wait time, optionally with a handler.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: The thread worker function for the timer or watchdog, executing the scheduled task or waiting for expiration.
